policy.ready_requires: Every requested keyframe has a current QC pass and matching SHA-256 hash.
policy.on_failure: Record the defect, adjust the shot's first_frame text, and generate again from the original presenter and product photos. Never edit the failed image and never use a generated image as a reference.
policy.failed_artifact_retention: Failed image files are deleted after review; their former filenames remain in this log as provenance only.
policy.source_frames: Never pass frames, grids or anchors cut from the reference video to the image model.
